scope: Frozen four-file component phase timing for the actual Root17 V7 stale-observation failures; diagnostic only

baseline.application_rule: Use the exact unique preimage fragments. This delta does not replace a shared source tree or any other agent's source. Parent owns integration, native scheduling and refs.

publication.failure: connect original CURRENT purpose: original Root writer observation unavailable or fenced

original_evidence.interpretation: The original current() safety check rejected actual request-start age beyond the unchanged limit. Its failure precedes session and worker drop. Parent PeerDenied/EAGAIN is insufficient to identify the first cause. last_checked is advanced by each current() and is not the observation response completion timestamp.
original_evidence.limitations: V7 does not contain successful per-phase timings that uniquely identify kernel scheduling, filesystem durability or a shared original owner callback as the budget consumer. Previous speculative clock-regression and contention theories are not treated as this run's cause.

diagnostics_contract.source_shape: Each span is a new timing guard immediately before unchanged existing work and an explicit drop immediately after it. Original ? paths drop the guard automatically. Removing just the new declarations and drops reproduces each entire old file byte for byte.
diagnostics_contract.callback_boundary: The fixture grant/claim/dispatch span wraps the whole original call. Its output occurs after that original call returns or unwinds. Parent registration spans likewise write after the original registration call returns or unwinds; they do not print inside a live authority callback.
diagnostics_contract.observation_only: The helper never calls live.current(), refresh(), cache acceptance, consumer synchronization or any authority API. Extra BOOTTIME samples are diagnostic only. Failure to sample becomes None and is neither returned nor used in an original decision.
diagnostics_contract.bounded_output: Shared helper reserves one of at most 64 output slots per process at construction, retains at most eight marks and 64 phase characters, and never returns an emitted slot. The shared writer may return an unused slot only for actual successful spans below its 20 ms logging threshold. Fixture spans do not apply that threshold.
diagnostics_contract.outcome: These fixture guards do not declare an Ok or error outcome. reported_outcome=None means scope termination, never a successful or failed test. Original error/assertion output remains the authority for the operation's actual result.
diagnostics_contract.diagnostic_limits: Instrumentation can perturb scheduling. Missing records or suppressed writer scopes do not prove inactivity. Timings combine CPU, scheduling, filesystem I/O and original locks; a span must not be labelled pure mutex waiting. New results belong only to the exact integrated source, not to the predecessor.
